rules: 1H bars, NY trading day (18:00 roll); day's running low (high) must take out the previous full day's low (high)
CISD level = high (low) of the consecutive down- (up-) close 1H series that made the extreme
large leg: |CISD level - extreme| >= 0.5 x ADR20 (prior full days)
substitute confirmation before any CISD close-through: a completed forex-grid 4H candle closes beyond the prior 4H candle's high (low)
one event per extreme (new extreme re-arms); decide at the confirming close, next M1 open; stop at the day's extreme; 2R; 10h
